_comment: SEARCH CONSOLE CONTRACT — not a convenience list.
https://aligator527.github.io is live and indexed. Every URL and file below is already known
to Google and may already be linked from elsewhere. The build must keep producing all of them,
scripts/check-i18n.mjs fails the build if any entry disappears. Adding entries is routine.
REMOVING OR RENAMING AN ENTRY IS A DELIBERATE ACT: it breaks a live URL, and nothing in the
toolchain will warn you a second time. Do it only together with a decision about redirects,
and record that decision. See tests/fixtures/README.md.
Paths are site-root-relative, so the same contract holds for the base-path build
(pnpm build:subpath), where every path is served under the configured base instead.
Extra pages are allowed — this is a floor, not a whitelist — so adding /ru/ and /ja/ routes
needs no change here beyond listing them once they are live.
